headline: Sylhet measles outbreak: 110 deaths reported as cases surge
summary: A child under two has died at MAG Osmani Medical College Hospital, adding to a growing toll of confirmed and suspected cases in the division.
details: A child aged 1 year and 11 months has died at MAG Osmani Medical College Hospital in Sylhet. This brings the total number of deaths from confirmed and suspected measles cases in the Sylhet division to 110.

According to the Sylhet Division unit of the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), 286 patients with suspected measles are currently receiving treatment across various hospitals in the division.
The DGHS report further reveals that 83 more suspected measles patients were admitted to hospitals within the last 24 hours alone.
Since January 1 of this year, laboratory tests have confirmed 634 measles cases in the Sylhet Division.
The health report indicates that 104 people have died after exhibiting symptoms of measles, while six deaths have been laboratory-confirmed as resulting from the virus.

headline_marked: Joe Root returns as [[England's Test captain]], Stephen Fleming named head coach
headline: Joe Root returns as England's Test captain, Stephen Fleming named head coach
summary: The all-time leading run-scorer returns to leadership after Ben Stokes' retirement, while former New Zealander Fleming takes over the coaching role.
details: England has reappointed Joe Root as Test captain and appointed former New Zealand batter Stephen Fleming as head coach following the departures of Ben Stokes and Brendon McCullum.

Root, 35, is England's all-time leading run-scorer in Tests with 14,114 runs, second only to Sachin Tendulkar globally. He previously captained the side in 64 matches between 2017 and 2022, winning 27 of them.
He will lead the team in the upcoming three-Test home series against Pakistan starting August 19, following Ben Stokes' retirement from international cricket in June.
Stephen Fleming, 53, brings a significant franchise cricket reputation, having led the Chennai Super Kings to five IPL titles and two Champions League T20 crowns.
Despite his success in T20s, Fleming has no previous experience coaching a red-ball international team, but he aims to build a winning environment for the next generation of players.
The transition comes as England looks to rebuild after a decline in results, having lost 18 of their last 37 Tests under Brendon McCullum's tenure.
Fleming will officially assume the role of coach after the series against Pakistan, with assistant coach Marcus Trescothick leading the side on an interim basis until then.
England currently sits seventh in the World Test Championship standings.
caption:
Joe Root is back in charge! England names the all-time leading run-scorer as Test captain and Stephen Fleming as head coach.

England has reappointed Joe Root as Test captain and appointed former New Zealand batter Stephen Fleming as head coach following the departures of Ben Stokes and Brendon McCullum.

Root, 35, is England's all-time leading run-scorer in Tests with 14,114 runs, second only to Sachin Tendulkar globally. He previously captained the side in 64 matches between 2017 and 2022, winning 27 of them.

He will lead the team in the upcoming three-Test home series against Pakistan starting August 19, following Ben Stokes' retirement from international cricket in June.

Stephen Fleming, 53, brings a significant franchise cricket reputation, having led the Chennai Super Kings to five IPL titles and two Champions League T20 crowns.

Despite his success in T20s, Fleming has no previous experience coaching a red-ball international team, but he aims to build a winning environment for the next generation of players.

The transition comes as England looks to rebuild after a decline in results, having lost 18 of their last 37 Tests under Brendon McCullum's tenure.

Fleming will officially assume the role of coach after the series against Pakistan, with assistant coach Marcus Trescothick leading the side on an interim basis until then.

England currently sits seventh in the World Test Championship standings.
